definitions: The action or art of imitating someone or something, typically in order to entertain or ridicule.
The close external resemblance of an animal or plant (or part of one) to another animal, plant, or inanimate object.
The resemblance of one organism to another or to an object in its surroundings for concealment and protection from predators.
examples: His mimicry of the teacher was spot on.
The insect's mimicry of a twig was remarkable.
Batesian mimicry is a common defence mechanism.
